name: AutoEval-Video
description: AutoEval-Video is a challenging benchmark for evaluating large vision-language models on open-ended video question answering across nine skill dimensions, covering perception, comprehension, and generation. It includes over 40 distinct video themes and uses an LLM-based evaluation approach with instance-specific rules to achieve high evaluation accuracy comparable to human evaluators.
typical_sota_score: ≈70–85% (aggregate scores vary by skill dimension and model; some skills notably lower)
reputation: A relatively new but increasingly cited video QA benchmark in the multimodal evaluation literature, especially for open-ended LLM-based video understanding.
notes: Uses GPT-4 as an automatic evaluator with adversarial annotation; highlights limitations of current vision-language models.
